core_obligations: (2): for a constructible subset stable under generalization and an irreducible closed subset meeting it, the generic point belongs to the subset, which is therefore dense in that closed subset and contains a nonempty open of it (proof lines 4026-4032)
Openness: the preceding property characterizes openness in a Noetherian space, so the subset is open (proof lines 4033-4034)
(1): apply (2) to the complement, which is constructible and stable under specialization (proof line 4035)
proof_roadmap: (2)：设 E 可构造且对一般化稳定；取与之相交的不可约闭子集 Y 及泛点 ξ，则 ξ ∈ E ⇒ E ∩ Y 稠密 ⇒ E 含 Y 的非空开集；由 Noetherian 空间开子集的刻画得 E 开。
(1)：把 (2) 用于补集（可构造且对特殊化稳定）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes closed, respectively open, subsets of a Noetherian space as the constructible ones stable under specialization, respectively generalization (author lemma at source lines 4014-4024, label lemma-characterize-closed-Noetherian). The proof (source lines 4026-4036) treats the generalization case through the generic point of an irreducible closed subset meeting the set, invokes the openness criterion and applies the result to the complement for the closed case (proof lines 4026-4035). The generic point argument is the substance. H3.
